name: fixture-correct
description: The CONTROL. It performs the acts, records them by their design/10 class through the real store, and replays from the record. All three legs must pass on it — without that, a broken column would look like a working one on the other three fixtures. It is a SELF-TEST fixture, not a gov-os custody surface: its replay folds the tree each record carried rather than re-deriving a filesystem. The first real record and replay adapters land with the mount at EP-25.

covers_map.note: design/10 §11.4a, declared by the target: what each record kind is ABOUT. The class-named kinds declare "*" — they are appended by the wrapper around the subject call itself, so the act they cover is the act under test and is named in their own payload. The deferred kinds name their act, because their whole point is to land in a later step than the one that caused them.
